assertions: The official GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/{tag} endpoint returns JoeanAmier/XHS-Downloader release 2.7 without authentication.
The release identity, publication state and four reviewed asset names, sizes and GitHub-provided SHA-256 digests match the fixed fixture.
The response uses GitHub REST API version 2026-03-10, the core rate bucket and an ETag; the Connector makes one bounded request without redirects or retries.

The normalized output excludes author/uploader identities, avatars, download counts, tarball/zipball links and raw payload; notes are reduced to a full-body SHA-256 plus at most 4096 characters, and assets are not downloaded or executed.
